title: How to Build a RAG on Supabase
description:
Most RAG tutorials send you to a separate vector database.
This one shows you how to build the entire system inside Supabase.

In this video, I walk through building a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system from scratch using Supabase and the pgvector extension. You'll see how to set up your project, enable vector search, generate and store embeddings, build a similarity search function, and connect it all to an LLM for accurate, grounded responses instead of hallucinated ones.

Whether you're building an internal knowledge base, a customer-facing AI assistant, or just want to understand how RAG actually works under the hood, this walkthrough covers the full stack in one sitting.
